title: Probabilistic Smooth Attention for Deep Multiple Instance Learning in Medical Imaging
core_idea: Introduce a probabilistic framework for deep multiple instance learning that models a probability distribution over attention values, accounting for both local (adjacent instances) and global (long-range) interactions, and enabling uncertainty-aware attention maps for instance-level contribution.
tldr: Model attention probabilistically within deep MIL for medical images to capture uncertainty and both local and global instance interactions.
